decision.root_cause_hypothesis: Exploration objectives are insufficiently incentivized: distance_from_center (weight 0.25) has not prevented clustering (std dropped from 0.0450 to 0.0101) and no parameter_spread objective is present, so the optimizer is prematurely exploiting a narrow region.
decision.rationale: Performance improved from ~0.0004 to mean=0.0527 (std=0.0016) but the population shows a tight performance spread (range ~0.011) and reduced diversity (distance_from_center mean=0.2926, std=0.0101). Adding parameter_spread (registered scorer) with weight comparable to distance_from_center should push the search to explore more varied parameter combinations and help escape local clustering.
decision.expected_benefit_hypothesis: Increase candidate-wise phenotypic diversity (std of parameters) and exploration of different regions, reducing premature convergence and increasing the chance of finding higher-performance designs.
decision.validation_plan_suggested_by_judge: After the change, monitor next 3 iterations for (a) an increase in diversity (parameter_spread std and distance_from_center std should rise from current ~0.01) and (b) improvement in best or mean performance beyond the current max 0.0548 or mean 0.0527. The independent validator will accept the change if it yields improved accepted-state metrics per its test.

decision.root_cause_hypothesis: Conflicting objective weights: diversity objectives (parameter_spread weight=0.25 + distance_from_center weight=0.35 = 0.60) are dominating optimization pressure and preventing focus on improving performance; this likely causes stagnation (zero objective variance) and low performance mean=0.0529. Implementation/sampling bug is possible but secondary at this stage.
decision.rationale: All objectives show zero population std (Analyzer), performance remains very low (mean=0.0529 ±0.0000) while diversity objectives combined weight = 0.60. Temporarily making performance the dominant objective should allow exploitation and reveal whether a performance gradient exists before further changes or debugging.
decision.expected_benefit_hypothesis: Shifts optimizer pressure toward improving performance (performance will have >~71% of weighted emphasis vs current diversity total), increasing chance to see objective variance and measurable performance gains if a gradient exists. If objective scores remain identical afterward, that will strengthen the evidence for an implementation/sampling bug.
decision.validation_plan_suggested_by_judge: Monitor next 2–5 iterations for (1) nonzero population std in objectives (objective std > 0), and (2) a rise in performance mean above 0.0529. If neither occurs, proceed to an implementation-targeted intervention (investigate candidate generation/evaluation).
